observation: The HTTPFUL-1 dogfood run produced reproducible evidence about agent-loop/agent-* tooling, but agent-loop 0.16.3 had no governed way to mark an ordinary Finding as being about an external package and hand those records upstream, so the evidence was stored in a parallel Markdown document.

evidence.summary: Thirteen tooling observations were written to docs/agents/agent-loop-findings.md because the host Learning root had no target-aware export path.

hypothesis: Dogfood feedback does not need a new ToolingFinding lifecycle; ordinary Findings need an optional external subject plus read-only owner-side export, with Run provenance reused from existing learning decisions.
validated_conclusion: The 0.16.3 consumer workflow lacked a governed upstream handoff for tooling findings; the demonstrated gap is external target identity/export on the existing Finding lifecycle, not a second feedback store or promotion pipeline.
